themeDescription: Confused customers, sizing ambiguity & product comparisons

challenges.title: Active Skincare Ingredients: Retinol vs Peptides
challenges.shortDescription: Demystify complex cosmetic active ingredients and recommend a gentle starter regimen for sensitive skin.
challenges.mission: Break down skincare jargon into simple daily steps, perform patch-test check, and build confidence.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I'm seeing fine lines under my eyes, but social media is so confusing! One influencer says use 1% retinol, another says it burns sensitive skin and to use peptides. I have no idea what to buy and I'm scared of damaging my face.

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: safety for sensitive skin and real results

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Asks multiple questions about side effects and application order.
hiddenObjectives: Explain difference between peptides (nourishing barrier) and retinol (cell renewal)
Recommend beginner low-strength or peptide starter kit with SPF

challenges.title: International Shoe Size Conversion Confusion
challenges.shortDescription: Measure the customer foot using a Brannock device and explain brand-specific width and conversion variances.
challenges.mission: Measure foot length and arch, explain differences between UK, US, and European sizing charts, and ensure comfortable fit.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Why is footwear shopping so maddening? In Nike I wear a US 10, in Adidas an 8.5 UK, and in Zara a 43! I just want a comfortable running shoe that won't pinch my toes!

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Compares different shoe boxes and expresses doubt.
hiddenObjectives: Explain foot width (wide toe box vs narrow heel)
Bring two adjacent sizes for direct walking trial

challenges.title: Parent Choosing College Engineering Laptop
challenges.shortDescription: Translate technical laptop specs into clear student benefits without pushing unnecessary expensive add-ons.
challenges.mission: Understand student college curriculum requirements (CAD/Coding), explain RAM and dedicated GPU simply, and recommend balanced value.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: My daughter is starting Computer Engineering next month. The sales boy in another shop told me I must spend 1.2 lakhs on an RTX graphics gaming laptop with 32GB RAM. Is that really necessary or was he just trying to fleece me?

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Shares course syllabus and budget constraints.
hiddenObjectives: Demystify GPU and RAM requirements for student programming
Highlight 16GB RAM + strong CPU sweet spot around 65k-75k
Focus on battery life and student warranty
possibleSolutions: Practical student laptop recommendation with 3-year warranty

challenges.title: Pure Linen vs Wrinkle-Free Blend Comparison
challenges.shortDescription: Guide a business traveler on fabric performance, breathability, and maintenance for hot humid travel destinations.
challenges.mission: Explain natural flax breathability versus wrinkle-resistant cotton blends, catering to the customer travel schedule.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I have a 4-day conference in humid Mumbai. I love how pure linen looks on the mannequin, but I hate ironing in hotel rooms. Will I look like a crumpled mess after a 2-hour taxi ride?

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: looking sharp without spending hours ironing

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Touches fabric samples and weighs pros and cons.
hiddenObjectives: Present linen-cotton or easy-care travel blend alternative
